name: CorrespondentRelationship
description: A correspondent banking relationship between the bank and a foreign financial institution. Tracks the EDD lifecycle, Senior Management approval, and ongoing monitoring schedule. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005) as the regulatory accountability system for MLR 2017 Regulation 34 compliance.

fields.name: relationship_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this correspondent relationship

fields.name: correspondent_bank_name
fields.description: Name of the foreign correspondent bank

fields.name: correspondent_bic
fields.description: SWIFT BIC of the correspondent bank

fields.name: correspondent_jurisdiction
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the correspondent bank's jurisdiction

fields.name: currency_corridor
fields.description: Currency pair enabled by this relationship (e.g. GBP-KES)

fields.name: fatf_risk_rating
fields.description: FATF risk rating: standard | enhanced | grey_list | black_list

fields.name: edd_completed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when EDD assessment was completed

fields.name: edd_document_ref
fields.description: Reference to EDD documentation in secure document store

fields.name: sanctions_hit
fields.description: Whether sanctions screening returned a positive hit

fields.name: sm_approval_ref
fields.description: Senior Management approval attestation reference (MLR 2017 R34)

fields.name: sm_approved_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of Senior Management approval

fields.name: nostro_account_id
fields.description: FK to nostro account in SVC-007 (set when relationship is active)

fields.name: status
fields.description: under_assessment | approved | active | suspended | rejected | terminated

fields.name: annual_review_due_date
fields.description: Next annual EDD review due date (MLR 2017 R34 ongoing monitoring)

fields.name: onboarded_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when relationship went live (first SWIFT message exchanged)

design_decisions: CorrespondentRelationship is owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005) — regulatory accountability per MLR 2017 R34 sits in CAP-005.
nostro_account_id is a reference to SVC-007's account entity — SVC-015 does not own the nostro account data.
sanctions_hit = true causes automatic status = rejected; no Senior Management override is permitted per bank policy.
